BiblicalUsage: Ranah is to whiz — the sound of the quiver rattling against the horse. God asks Job of the war horse, 'The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.'
TheologicalSignificance: This tells me that the whizzing quiver is the horse's courage: he does not fear the rattle, he smells the battle afar off — and God made him that way.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
